opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a money-making opportunity, calling it a “Best Earnings Platform” and “Life-changing Oprtunity,” while directing viewers toward WhatsApp contact. It reinforces that invitation with a rapid-earnings testimonial: “This system has given me 3 days of payment of 1 lakh.” The Forsage profile visibly displays separate Partners and Team metrics, a Forsage Programs section, and BUSD and BNB amounts, presenting the structure and its earnings figures as reasons to participate. Taken together, the promotional title, recruitment pathway, tiered partner-and-team presentation, and high-value payment claim support participation rather than offering a warning, investigation, or neutral explanation.
